kbArticles.title: Membership Registration & KYC Document Verification Guide
kbArticles.summary: Comprehensive guidelines for new members on required identification, registration fee payments, and verifying cooperative eligibility.
kbArticles.content:
# Membership Eligibility & KYC Guidelines

Welcome to Wabi SACCO! To become an active cooperative member and access our financial services, please review the requirements below:

### 1. Eligibility Criteria
- Ethiopian citizen or resident above 18 years of age.
- Clean credit background and commitment to regular savings.
- One-time non-refundable registration fee of **ETB 250.00**.
- Minimum initial share purchase requirement of **5 shares (ETB 2,500.00)**.

### 2. Required KYC Documents
1. **Valid Kebele ID, National Digital ID (Fayda), or Passport**.
2. **Passport-sized color photograph** (white background).
3. **Official Bank Deposit Slip or Mobile Money Reference (CBE/Telebirr)** proving payment of registration fee and initial shares.
4. **Designated Beneficiary (Nominee) Information** including National ID number and relationship.

### 3. Verification Timeline
Once submitted, our Member Onboarding Desk reviews submissions within **24–48 business hours**. You will receive an SMS and email notification with your permanent **Membership Number (e.g. WB000143)** upon approval.

kbArticles.title: Understanding Savings Products: Regular, Voluntary & Fixed Term
kbArticles.summary: Comparison of interest rates, withdrawal rules, minimum monthly balances, and deposit mechanisms across all Wabi savings tiers.
kbArticles.content:
# Wabi SACCO Savings Portfolio Overview

We offer three structured savings tiers designed to optimize capital growth and liquidity:

| Product Tier | Annual Interest Rate | Min. Monthly Deposit | Withdrawal Notice | Holding Period |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Regular Compulsory** | **8.5% p.a.** (Compound) | ETB 500.00 | Non-withdrawable | Active membership |
| **Voluntary Flexible** | **6.0% p.a.** (Simple) | ETB 100.00 | Immediate / 3 Days | None |
| **Fixed Term Deposit** | **11.5% – 13.0% p.a.** | ETB 10,000.00 | Maturity Date | 6, 12, or 24 Months |

### Key Rules
- **Regular Savings**: Acts as loan collateral multiplier (3x). Cannot be withdrawn unless terminating membership.
- **Voluntary Savings**: Free deposit and withdrawal for daily liquidity needs.
- **Early Liquidation of Fixed Deposits**: Allowed with 30-day written notice; incurs 25% forfeiture of accrued interest.

kbArticles.title: Share Capital Ownership & Annual Dividend Distribution Rules
kbArticles.summary: Everything you need to know about cooperative equity shares, voting rights, secondary share transfers, and dividend calculations.
kbArticles.content:
# Cooperative Equity Shares & Dividend Rights

### 1. Share Value & Minimum Thresholds
- **Par Value per Share**: Fixed at **ETB 500.00** as set by the SACCO General Assembly.
- **Statutory Minimum**: Every active member must hold at least **5 shares (ETB 2,500.00)**.
- **Maximum Cap**: No individual member may hold more than **10% of total SACCO capital** to prevent undue concentration.

### 2. Dividend Payouts
- Dividends are declared at the Annual General Assembly following external audit.
- Historical average dividend yield has ranged between **13.5% and 15.0%**.
- Members may choose between **Direct Cash Payout (to voluntary savings)** or **Automatic Share Reinvestment**.

### 3. Share Transfers
Shares cannot be redeemed for cash directly from the SACCO treasury. If terminating membership, shares are transferred to an existing member or sold to an incoming approved applicant with Board approval.

kbArticles.title: Loan Eligibility Criteria, 3x Multiplier & Guarantor Guidelines
kbArticles.summary: Detailed underwriting requirements, savings multiplier calculation, collateral standards, and guarantor liability agreements.
kbArticles.content:
# Loan Application & Underwriting Standards

### 1. Basic Qualification
1. Must have maintained **active membership for at least 4 consecutive months**.
2. Consistent monthly regular savings without default.
3. Minimum share ownership satisfied (5 shares minimum).

### 2. Maximum Loan Limit (The 3x Rule)
Your maximum borrowing capacity is **3 times your accumulated Regular Compulsory Savings balance**:
$\text{Max Loan Amount} = \text{Regular Savings Balance} \times 3.0$

*Example*: If your regular savings balance is ETB 50,000, your maximum loan ceiling is **ETB 150,000**.

### 3. Guarantor Requirements
- Loans exceeding your own savings balance require **guarantors who are active SACCO members in good standing**.
- Each guarantor can pledge up to their available unencumbered savings balance.
- A member may guarantee a maximum of **3 active loans concurrently**.

kbArticles.title: How to Make Deposits & Submit Bank/Mobile Money Transfer Receipts
kbArticles.summary: Step-by-step instructions for depositing through Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE), Telebirr, and uploading transaction slips for verification.
kbArticles.content:
# Deposit Payment Channels & Receipt Verification

To ensure fast crediting to your passbook, follow these deposit instructions:

### Authorized Bank & Mobile Money Accounts
- **Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE)**: Account `1000234567890` (Wabi SACCO Main Operations)
- **Telebirr Merchant Code**: `554433` (Wabi SACCO Savings)
- **Awash Bank**: Account `01320495867400`

### Step-by-Step Deposit & Slip Upload
1. Make your transfer via CBE Mobile Banking, ATM, Branch deposit, or Telebirr.
2. Ensure the transfer narration/reason includes your **Membership Number (e.g. WB000143)**.
3. Log into your **Member Portal** and navigate to **Receipt Verification / Upload Deposit**.
4. Attach the screenshot or scanned photo (PNG/JPG/PDF) and enter the exact transaction reference.
5. Our tellers review and verify receipts during banking hours within **2 hours**.

kbArticles.title: Account Security, Password Reset & Two-Factor Authentication
kbArticles.summary: Best security practices to protect your cooperative accounts, reset forgotten passwords, and enable OTP SMS verification.
kbArticles.content:
# Security Best Practices for Members

### 1. Password Safety
- Use a strong passphrase with at least 8 characters including numbers and special symbols.
- Never share your password, OTP SMS codes, or PIN with anyone — including SACCO staff!

### 2. Forgotten Password Recovery
- Click **Forgot Password** on the login page.
- Enter your registered email or phone number.
- You will receive a 6-digit OTP code valid for 10 minutes.
- Enter the code to establish your new password.

### 3. Reporting Suspicious Activity
If you observe unauthorized login notifications or receipt submissions, immediately create a **CRITICAL Priority Ticket** or call our emergency hotline at `+251-11-555-0199`.

kbArticles.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for Cooperative Members
kbArticles.summary: Quick answers to top questions on working hours, office locations, interest calculation periods, and official letters.
kbArticles.content:
# Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q1: What are Wabi SACCO branch opening hours?
**A:** Monday to Friday: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM; Saturday: 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.

### Q2: How often is savings interest credited?
**A:** Interest is accrued daily on the end-of-day ledger balance and officially posted to your passbook on the **last day of every calendar month**.

### Q3: Can I request an official Bank Confirmation Letter for Visa or Loan?
**A:** Yes! Simply submit a **Service Request Ticket** under the "Savings" category specifying the embassy or institution name. Letters are prepared with official stamp within 24 hours.

### Q4: How do I change my nominated beneficiaries?
**A:** Go to **My Profile & KYC** in the member portal, update your nominee details and upload a copy of their ID.
